verification_methodology_note: PRIMARY SOURCES: this track's current-consolidated text rests on TWO independent official sources in agreement: (1) ZATCA's (Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority) own official consolidated Arabic PDF of the VAT Law, downloaded directly and extracted with pdftotext -- the source for the two amended articles' (2 and 49) current text, with explicit footnotes citing the amending instruments; (2) laws.boe.gov.sa (Bureau of Experts portal), reached via the r.jina.ai proxy after the live page returned HTTP 503, used to cross-verify all other (unamended) articles word-for-word, and also to corroborate decree/preamble metadata (Shura Council Resolution 128/45, Council of Ministers Resolution 654). The Wayback Machine was unreachable this pass (TLS connection reset in all attempts despite a confirmed available snapshot) and was not part of this track's verification chain, unlike some other tracks in this corpus -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies. IMPORTANT: the BOE portal's default view is NOT automatically consolidated with amendments -- for both amended articles (2 and 49) the BOE-portal rendering showed pre-amendment (or truncated/anomalous) text, confirming ZATCA's PDF (not the BOE portal) as the authoritative current-text source for those two articles specifically. Neither article's full pre-amendment original text was captured to primary-source confidence this pass -- no original_1438h_text fields are included for either, per this corpus's zero-fabrication policy; both gaps are documented, not guessed, and flagged as candidates for a dedicated follow-up pass. A companion Implementing Regulation is confirmed to exist (ZATCA Board Decision 3839, 14 Dhul-Hijjah 1438H, amended at least 12 times through 2024/2025) but is not extracted in this track.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: Article 2 is confirmed amended by Royal Order A/638 (15/10/1441H), raising the VAT rate from 5% to 15% (effective 1 July 2020). The pre-amendment original text was NOT reliably recoverable this pass: the BOE portal's rendering of this article (via the r.jina.ai proxy) showed only a single incomplete sentence with no rate percentage and no second paragraph -- inconsistent with the article's known two-paragraph structure -- most likely a rendering/extraction artifact rather than genuine original wording, but this could not be fully ruled out. Per this corpus's zero-fabrication policy, no original_1438h_text field is included -- the gap is documented here, not guessed or reconstructed.

Article 49 is confirmed amended by Royal Decree M/52 (28/4/1441H) -- the reference to "الجهة القضائية المختصة" (the competent judicial body) was replaced with a reference to the newly-created Tax Violations and Disputes Resolution Committees. The BOE portal's default view showed the pre-amendment wording as a single truncated sentence fragment ("...التظلم منه أمام الجهة القضائية المختصة..."), confirming the BOE portal's default view is not automatically consolidated with amendments, but the FULL pre-amendment article text was not captured in this research pass. Per this corpus's zero-fabrication policy, no original_1438h_text field is included -- flagged as a candidate for a dedicated follow-up pass to recover the complete original wording directly from the BOE portal.

The Official Gazette publication date of Royal Decree M/113 is reported inconsistently: laws.boe.gov.sa states "تاريخ النشر" = 21/3/1440H (29/11/2018G), while eastlaws.com states Umm Al-Qura issue 4681 dated 5/11/1438H (28/7/2017G) -- roughly 16 months apart. These may refer to different events (original Gazette publication vs. a later BOE-portal listing/registration date), but this could not be confirmed. Not reconciled; both dates recorded here for transparency.

ZATCA's own consolidated PDF of the Implementing Regulation prints "قرار رقم (3839) وتاريخ 14 ذو الحجة 1438هـ الموافق 14 نوفمبر 2016م" -- but 14 Dhul-Hijjah 1438H computes (via the standard tabular Hijri algorithm) to 5 September 2017, not November 2016, while all other Gregorian-equivalent dates printed elsewhere in the same document check out correctly against the same conversion method. This looks like an isolated error in ZATCA's own PDF (a pdftotext font-mapping warning was also logged on this exact page) -- flagged for visual confirmation against the source PDF, not silently corrected. Not consequential to this track since the Implementing Regulation itself is not extracted.

Article 26 has no chapter heading immediately preceding it in the source document's own layout and sits under Chapter 10's heading (الإقرار الضريبي / Tax Return) even though its subject matter (tax assessment by the Authority) arguably reads more naturally with Chapter 11 (سداد الضريبة / Tax Payment). Reported exactly as it appears in both primary sources (ZATCA PDF and BOE portal) -- not corrected or re-grouped.

Multiple direct-curl attempts to web.archive.org (plain HTTP, HTTPS with/without explicit proxy, forcing TLS 1.2, forcing HTTP/2) all resulted in connection resets at the TLS-handshake stage, despite the Wayback CDX/availability API confirming a snapshot exists (20251116114222). This appears to be a genuine environment-level network restriction. This track's cross-verification instead rests on the ZATCA official PDF (primary, administering-agency source) cross-checked against laws.boe.gov.sa (official BOE portal, reached via the r.jina.ai proxy after the live page returned HTTP 503) -- a Wayback Machine snapshot was not part of this track's verification chain, unlike some other tracks in this corpus.
